policy.full_frame_budget: floor(f*N_full); rank successful files; failed files receive no score and no automated review; unused slots remain unfilled
policy.common_success_budget: floor(f*N_common); intersection across ALL declared methods from statuses before reference join
policy.pipeline_recall_denominator: all full-frame reference positives including failed-score positives
policy.paired_targets: within the same domain and planned budget only; cross-domain contrasts are not method comparisons
policy.failure_triage: No manual failure triage or fallback is included; such a policy needs a separate prespecified budget
policy.unknowns: Never dropped or called negative; suppress AP/ratio/difference in affected domain; workload endpoint bounds remain available

limitations: AP and recall ratios are nonlinear generally biased plug-ins
Percentile and normal intervals are design approximations; rare-positive coverage is not guaranteed
Shared replicates retain paired covariance but do not prove interval coverage
No multiplicity correction or cross-class covariance inference
No new-family interval, model-training uncertainty or validation of human-reference correctness
Common-success selection is score-status dependent and changes target population; no extrapolation to failed files
